test_read_iceberg: test read_iceberg to load an Apache Iceberg table from a SQLite catalog into a pandas DataFrame
test_read_iceberg_by_catalog_name: test read_iceberg with catalog_name parameter to load a table using a named catalog configuration
test_read_iceberg_with_row_filter: test read_iceberg with row_filter parameter to filter rows by a boolean expression
test_read_iceberg_with_case_sensitive: test read_iceberg with case_sensitive parameter to control column name matching for column selection
test_read_iceberg_with_limit: test read_iceberg with limit parameter to restrict the number of rows returned
test_write_iceberg: test DataFrame.to_iceberg to write a DataFrame to a new Apache Iceberg table in a catalog
test_write_iceberg_by_catalog_name: test DataFrame.to_iceberg with catalog_name parameter to write using a named catalog configuration
test_write_iceberg_append_true: test DataFrame.to_iceberg with append=True to add rows to an existing table
test_write_iceberg_append_false: test DataFrame.to_iceberg with append=False to replace all data in an existing table
